name: DURANT Marketplace
summary: DURANT Marketplace is Oakland's popular indoor flea market featuring a diverse mix of new and used items including clothing, electronics, and household goods. With over 1,400 reviews and a 4-star rating, this community destination offers bargain hunters an exciting treasure-hunting experience in a convenient indoor setting.
demographics: DURANT Marketplace attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic primarily from Oakland's International Boulevard corridor and surrounding East Bay communities. The visitor base includes working-class families, bargain hunters, and multicultural shoppers seeking affordable new and used goods, with a strong representation of Hispanic and Asian households. The trade area serves middle to lower-middle income residents who prioritize value and variety, with many visitors making regular trips to find deals on clothing, electronics, and household items in the indoor flea market environment.
description: DURANT Marketplace stands as Oakland's premier indoor flea market destination, offering a unique shopping experience at 10950 International Boulevard. This bustling community marketplace brings together vendors selling an eclectic mix of new and used merchandise, from clothing and electronics to household goods and specialty items. Operating daily from 10 AM to 7 PM, the center has earned a solid 4-star rating from over 1,400 Google reviews, reflecting its popularity among East Bay bargain hunters and treasure seekers. The indoor format provides year-round comfort while maintaining the excitement and discovery of traditional flea market shopping. Located in Oakland's diverse International Boulevard district, DURANT Marketplace serves as a vital community gathering place where shoppers can find affordable goods, unique finds, and a vibrant multicultural shopping atmosphere that reflects the rich diversity of the surrounding neighborhoods.
